verdict.rationale: Qdrant documents a distributed deployment mode in which multiple Qdrant services distribute data across peers to increase stability, which touches the high-availability core of the story. However, the evidence never explicitly describes replicas, replication factors, zone-aware placement, or any consistency model. Missing for 10: explicit replication/replication-factor docs, cross-zone placement, documented consistency model (e.g., write consistency or read guarantees), failover behavior, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can replicate data across nodes or zones for high availability with a documented consistency model

citations.quote: Qdrant supports a distributed deployment mode. In this mode, multiple Qdrant services communicate with each other to distribute the data across the peers to extend the storage capabilities and increase stability.
